name: zhang-zengjie/robot-raw-collision-signals
text: Raw torque sensor data from robot collision and intentional contact experiments. Dataset Structure: each part contains 42 compressed packages. Each package contains time-series torque data. The scripts document signal segmentation and seven joint channels. Part I: https://zenodo.org/records/21927431 Part II: https://zenodo.org/records/21941203

name: Raw Torque Data — Part I: Accidental Collisions
text: 206 accidental collision sequences of raw torque sensor signals sampled at 1 kHz for all seven joints. Data are stored in MATLAB (.mat) format and archived as time-series batches. Dataset structure and units are documented.

name: Raw Torque Data — Part II: Intentional Contacts
text: 239 intentional contact sequences of raw torque sensor signals sampled at 1 kHz for all seven joints. Data are stored in MATLAB (.mat) format and archived as time-series batches. Dataset structure and units are documented.
